integrity.review_scope: Same-model correctness, originality and value assessment of the specified theorem only

object: Simple perfect evolution algebras with nonzero weights on one directed n-cycle over a finite field
scientific_limitations: No classification for zero weights or non-cycle support graphs.
For arbitrary finite fields, class counts and automorphism orders are proved but not all abstract automorphism group isomorphism types.
Literature priority remains subject to broader undetected covering theorems.
Finite computer tests are corroboration, not a proof of unbounded claims.

scope.base_fields: F_q for arbitrary prime power q
scope.special_family: F_4 all n >= 2; nonsplit extension for n divisible by six

title: Arithmetic isomorphism and automorphism spectra of weighted cyclic evolution algebras
